main.description: Manually deploy a repository's site now. Authenticated with the caller's serviceauth token (audience = the sites worker's DID); only the repository owner may trigger. Queues the deploy; the outcome is recorded in the repository's deploy history.

repoDid.description: DID of the repository to deploy.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.description: Only the repository owner can deploy.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: No repository record publishes this repo DID.

errors.name: OwnershipUnverifiable
errors.description: Repository ownership could not be verified.

errors.name: SiteConfigDisputed
errors.description: The stored site config names a different owner and must be re-saved by the repository owner.

errors.name: SiteNotFound
errors.description: The repository has no site configuration or the owner has no active claim.

errors.name: WorkerUnavailable
errors.description: The sites Worker could not be reached.
